_readme: Ground truth is (expected_source, required_keywords), not a chunk ID — see 00_shared/metrics.py module docstring for why. expected_source is matched as a substring of the chunk's metadata['source'] path. required_keywords: a chunk counts as relevant if it contains ANY of these (case-insensitive). Each question also states which spec section it should come from, for the human-readable report / EVALUATION.md table.
